miss: schematic bar fills were pale pastels (cat-*!35-60 on white), hard to see against the page

rule: data-figure bar/point/line fills must be mid-dark saturated (mix toward BLACK, e.g. hue!50!black), never toward white; verify on the render

miss: reported bars darkened from the SOURCE edit without re-rendering or viewing; the deliverable still showed pale bars, a replace_all substring collision made a malformed color (cat-skill!75!black!black), and the darkening direction was backwards (!80!black is light)

rule: NEVER report a visual/style change (color/bold/size/layout) as done without re-rendering the deliverable AND viewing the pixels; after token/color replace_all grep for malformed or duplicated specs (e.g. !black!black); color!P!black darkens as P DECREASES

miss: in subplot (d) all 4 category bars shared one fill (cat-code) and (b) both bars shared one hue; distinguishable only by height/label, not colour
why_missed: TWO gaps: (1) the auditor was never actually run, and (2) even its checklist had no rule that a categorical bar chart needs a distinct-per-bar palette
rule: in a categorical bar chart each bar for a distinct category gets a distinct, similarly-dark colour; on the render confirm no two bars in one subplot share a fill. But the deeper fix is to RUN the render+view gate, not to add checks to an un-invoked agent

miss: the hook and docs said 'spawn the parity-auditor subagent', but subagent_type 'parity-auditor' fails with 'agent type not found' -- .claude/agents/*.md are checklists here, not invokable agent types
